title: Book Three · Chapter 33: The Third Lap in Spring
story:
A few weeks later, early spring brings a warm Friday.

Ronan leaves his coat in the classroom at lunch. Kai has a ball, but he is going to meet friends on the other side of the field.

“Later?” he asks.

“Maybe. I'm going to the track.”

Ronan runs two laps again. The second is still hard. He finishes, walks a little, and goes to the bench.

Anna's friend is already there. Anna is on the far side of the track.

“Third?” Ronan asks.

The girl nods. “Nearly there.”

Ronan takes a drink. Across the grass, Kai calls to another boy. A ball moves between them.

Anna comes around the last turn. Her steps are short, but they keep the same beat. She does not stop at the place where she walked last time.

Her friend stands up beside the bench.

“Keep going.”

Anna looks toward them and runs on. At the line, she slows down. She walks past the bench once, then comes back.

“Three,” she says.

Her friend holds out the bottle. Anna takes it with both hands.

“All running?” Ronan asks.

She nods. “Slow. But all running.”

She drinks and sits down. For a while, the three of them watch the boys on the grass.

Then Anna's friend points toward a board near the field entrance.

“The spring running day. They put it up this morning.”

Anna looks over. “I want to read it.”

They collect their bottles and walk to the board. The notice has several short races and one longer run. Ronan follows the lines with his eyes.

A date is at the top. It is several weeks away, so Anna has time to ask.

Anna points to the longer run.

“How far?” her friend asks.

“It doesn't say here.”

Below the list is the sports teacher's room number. Anna takes out a scrap of paper and writes it down.

“I will ask next week,” she says.

Ronan looks at the shorter races. He does not choose one today. Kai calls from the grass, and he lifts a hand.

“I'm going over there.”

Anna nods. Her friend wants another look at the notice. They stay by the board as Ronan goes to the ball game.

Kai passes to him. Ronan stops the ball with his foot and sends it back.

“Warm enough?” Kai asks.

“My legs are.”

They play until the bell. Ronan takes the stairs with the other boys. At the classroom door, he hears Anna talking about the longer run.

She puts the paper inside her maths book. Then she moves her bottle away from his clean notebook.

Ronan sits down. He has a little grass on one shoe and a full afternoon ahead.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

beat＝节奏；entrance＝入口；notice＝通知；sports teacher＝体育老师。

## 理解问题

1. Anna这次怎样完成了三圈？这和她上次的尝试有什么区别？
2. 她对春季跑步活动采取了什么下一步行动？Ronan是否替她决定了项目？

## 读句子

**She puts the paper inside her maths book.**

拆开看：She / puts the paper / inside her maths book.

她／把那张纸／放进她的数学书里。
